compare.openTitle: Every measure of two or more volumes side by side, with charts
compare.title: Compare volumes
compare.needTwo: Pick two or more volumes to compare. Draw them in the Volumes panel.
compare.pickTitle: Compare this volume; click its name to fly to it
compare.scope: {rows} rows shown, {matches} matches. Counts follow the filters, hidden groups and time window.
compare.empty: Nothing to show for these volumes in the rows shown.
compare.sortHint: Click a volume's heading to sort the measures by how far it is from the first volume; click Measure for the usual order.
compare.effectTitle: Effect size against the first volume: Cohen's d over the matches (d), or Cliff's delta over the visits (δ).
compare.group.class: Vehicle class, share of the time inside
compare.group.actor: Player or AI, share of the time inside
compare.group.team: Team, share of the time inside
compare.group.dir: Facing, share of the rows with a direction
compare.bars.hint: Click a bar to show only that value in the view; click it again to show everything.
compare.time.hint: One chart per volume, on one scale. Click a point to move the playhead there.
compare.time.noJump: The matches keep their own clocks, so a time into the match is not one moment of the playback.
compare.visits.hint: A visit runs from entering a volume to leaving it. Box: the middle half, line: the median, whiskers: 5th to 95th percentile; the shape behind it: how the visits spread.
compare.flow.hint: Where a track went after each volume: its next volume, back into the same one (the diagonal), or the end of its match. Overlapping volumes count for the first in the list.
compare.legend: Click a volume to fly to it.
